verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime original-Czech novel book-publication span, from The Absolute at Large to War with the Newts, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The six markers use Czech book-edition years, not composition, newspaper serialization, later translations or adaptations; English titles are supplied for readability. The Absolute at Large began serialization in Lidové noviny in 1921 before its 1922 book and 1927 English translation. Krakatit uses its 1924 Czech book, not the 1925 English translation. The trilogy Hordubal, Meteor and An Ordinary Life appeared as Czech books in 1933, 1934 and 1934. The unfinished Life and Work of the Composer Foltýn appeared posthumously in 1939 and does not extend the bar. Plays, including R.U.R., short stories, collaborations, travel books, journalism and nonfiction are outside this novel-only scope.
